nom: Ducray Keracnyl Foaming Gel 400ml Face and Body Hygiene of Oily Skins with Acne Tendency (Packed of 2)

avis.texte: I've been using the Ducray Keracnyl Foaming Gel and it works well for my skin. It cleans thoroughly but still feels gentle, especially for acne-prone skin. My skin feels fresh after washing and not tight or dry. A good daily cleanser if you're dealing with breatouts.
